reviews.author: Shounette Coad
reviews.text:
I am submitting this complaint regarding a recent service visit from AAA Plumbing Company, which I believe involved unethical conduct. During the visit, the technician claimed there was over a foot of water underneath my home after he repaired a leak, and stated that it required water restoration services. He informed me that he needed to contact the office and then directed me to call someone named Cliff with Restoration Pros. He also suggested that the situation could be handled through my home insurance company.

However, I sought a second opinion the following day. The findings from the second company directly contradicted the initial assessment. Additionally, the photo shown to me by the AAA Plumbing technician did not match what was observed during the second inspection. I was informed that there was only a small puddle of water under my home, not the significant flooding that had been described.

This raises serious concerns that the situation may have been exaggerated in an attempt to upsell unnecessary services. As a homeowner, I expect honesty, accuracy, and transparency when receiving professional evaluations.

I respectfully request that this matter be reviewed. No customer should feel misled or pressured into services that may not be required.

When I asked why it was cut so big, he claimed it was standard procedure, which is absolutely not the case with other electricians. The light switch he installed also does not sit flush against the wall.

Customer service has been nonexistent. I called twice over the span of a week asking to speak to a manager and was promised callbacks that never happened. reviews.author: Beth
reviews.text:
I'm here to warn others about the incompetence of the technicians and the horrible business practices they partake in.

I had them out for a general maintenance on my plumbing. I was told my PSI valve was broken and needed repair and with that repair, I needed a new retention tank as well. Mind you, my house is only 3 yrs old so my equipment is also only 3 yrs old. They tried to do some fear tactics by telling me without this fix the water pressure in my home will destroy my fixtures and my pipes and I'll have a larger issue.

I decided to get a second opinion and yes, I am getting too much water pressure to my house but a simple tightening of the bolt fixed it. I don't need a new value or a new retention tank. But the technicians who came out, didn't even attempt to fix that, instead they quoted me $1,000! The guy who came out also tried to scare me into getting a water filter for my whole house because I have chlorine in my water and that causes cancer. I encourage everyone to get a second opinion or go with a smaller company that has more knowledgeable technicians and aren't trying to scam you out of money.

reviews.author: Max Bristol
reviews.text: Loved my experience. I called for assistance and I couldn’t ask for a better dispatch technician than Travis. He quickly identified my issue and did an impeccable repair.

reviews.author: Brian Beck
reviews.text: Very quick to respond. I could have had a Serbia tech at my home with an hour , if needed. When they arrive for the appointment, everything was on the truck the tech needed to fix my two issues. Happy with the service as I no longer have a dripping shower or faucet. My only negative was the end cost. It seemed high to me but this is the first experience with a plumber I have ever needed in my 61 years. I would recommend this company based on the convenience.

reviews.text:

The entire process was smooth, professional, and efficient.Oscar did a great job.  Very professional and answered all of my questions.

From that first phone call to the final installation, everything was handled flawlessly. We couldn’t be happier with the service and will absolutely use Benjamin Franklin Plumbing again — and recommend them without hesitation.

reviews.author: Jenna Blankenship
reviews.text: Don't use them! They'll tell you they fixed it, leave, then your house will be destroyed. He 'fixed it', charged me $300, told me I was "good to go", left, then my entire kitchen flooded. I had to call a plumber back out 3 hours after the initial call, and they charged us AGAIN. Now I have $20k+ worth of damage in my house that they refuse to fix. DON'T USE THIS COMPANY.

reviews.author: Will O
reviews.text: Roto-Rooter came down late in the evening to take care of a clogged and overflowing toilet for us. We were unable to use any of our water fixtures upstairs because of the overflow problem downstairs. Roto-Rooter came down and handled it very efficiently and completely. The plumber was really fast, neat and respectful. I would definitely recommend the service for an emergency situation like ours.

reviews.author: Sharleen Cruz
reviews.text:

When he saw how serious the issue was, he reassured us that his team would do everything they could to get things fixed as quickly as possible.

reviews.author: Lauren

He was knowledgeable, straightforward, and genuinely helpful. We trust him completely and will absolutely call Zach first for anything like this in the future. If you’re lucky enough to get him, you’re in very good hands.

reviews.author: C Smith

reviews.author: Kevin Tritch

reviews.author: Elizabeth Newsome

reviews.author: Gerry Hartman
reviews.text: Our family has used M&D Plumbing services for a variety of needs over the last 5 years with great, reliable results - they are my go to for trusted plumbing services. Fernando has come out several times and he is an absolute rock star - very good at the work and knowledgeable, but also very personable and very good about explaining situations and options.  Also I need to mention Adam, he does a great job of following up after service to make sure I'm satisfied - this is a great feature of dealing with M&D Plumbing - they actually care about customer satisfaction, quality work and reputation.  One other point - I don't have a name, but the front office staff who do the scheduling are great to work with as well - they are excellent about getting service folks scheduled to come out quickly, and ensuring arrival time estimates are communicated.  Pricing is definitely fair and justified - no padding and no offering services that aren't really required.  All in all, a great company!

reviews.author: Janna Matson Stokes
reviews.text: M.D. Plumbing was outstanding to work with from start to finish. I highly recommend M.D. Plumbing to anyone in need of reliable, professional service and will definitely be using them again in the future. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

title: All About The Pipes Plumbing
address: 4913 Chastain Ave, Charlotte, NC 28217, United States

reviews.author: Nicole
reviews.text: Consider yourself lucky if this company did your work correctly. To make a long story short, they didnt fix and / or misdiagnosed  issues. When I contacted the owner, Mary, she was incredibly condescending. The contractor that hired her for job had to corroborate my claim to which she still didn’t acknowledge. The contractor eventually brought in another plumber, who successfully fixed the real problems, proving this company’s diagnosis of several issues was entirely wrong. Despite this, Mary responded back in writing that she stood by her team’s original recommendations. She even refused in good faith to compensate the $250 I wasted on an unnecessary tub filler. At the very least, this company exhibits terrible customer service. I advise avoiding this company. Yes they will handle straightforward jobs that require minimal effort. But if you want a business owner who prioritizes a job well done coupled with customer satisfaction over personal pride, you will be disappointed here.

reviews.author: Janeene Humphrey
reviews.text: I was referred to this company by my neighbor who said they did a good job for her.  I called and the nicest woman answered the phone.  She went above and beyond to answer my questions and even told me that I probably did not have a plumbing issue, but an appliance issue.  Who does that in this day and age?  She even recommended her personal contractor for my flooring issues! I truly appreciate her candor and honesty.  She is DEFINITELY the person I would call if I had any issues.  Someone you can trust is priceless. What a gem to have in Charlotte!

reviews.author: Alyssa Martens
reviews.text: My technician Chaz was just a total gem. Found the issue, proposed multiple solutions at different price points and gave me insights into details about my plumbing pipes and systems that will be valuable for future work. Got an appointment very quickly and the price was extremely reasonable. This is a female-owned, NON-PE BACKED (so important) family run business. I will be using All About the Pipes for all my future plumbing needs.

reviews.author: Joe D. Rich
reviews.text: All About The Pipes is simply the best.  They have helped us with many issues from toilet repair to hot water heaters and we have always been happy with the service.  They are on time; the quality of the work is good;  and the price has always been fair.  The communication is also very good and they will take time to explain the exact issue in detail to make sure you understand the scope of the project.  ....Just a great company!!  The technicians are always very considerate and friendly.

reviews.author: Bob O'Neill
reviews.text: We’ve been longtime customer of All About the Pipes relying on their services for 20+ years. Always have our best interest in mind to understand and help resolve the issue. I will recommend Mary and her team to everyone.

reviews.author: Barbara P
reviews.text:
My 99 year old home had virtually no water pressure or hot water due to sediment-filled galvanized pipes and hot water supply lines running in every direction under the house. Trickles of water from the faucets and cold showers were the norm, yet repiping the entire house is a huge project. I compiled an initial contact list of 11 plumbers, all from friends, colleagues and neighbors. All About The Pipes was a neighbor's referral.
The inspection was very thorough and the quote followed promptly. Pricing was fantastic and more than fair. Communication is person-to-person. All phone calls were answered and all email received. AATP exceeded my expectations in every way!
Honestly, I cannot say enough about this small, local company!
Mary, Alex, Noah and Jason are knowledgeable, process oriented -  seeking to find the root of the problem and solve it rather than using workarounds or swapping parts as a shortcut. Additionally, my home has a crawl space that gets very narrow towards the back of the house. They dealt with that inconvenience without complaint. Alex even crawled to the back of the house during the initial inspection. There were no delays or surprises. Fantastic communication from the first call to the final payment. My home was left in good order, I was never inconvenienced in any way during the course of the project. All plumbers were very aware and respectful of my cats - always making sure the doors were closed and latched. Good folks!
The trickles of water and cold showers are in the past. Everything  works well - better than ever.

It is crucial we support our small and local companies rather than the giants with hundreds of employees who seem bound more to their metrics and pushing upsells than developing a real loyalty with a customer built on great work and communication.
Many thanks to Mary, Alex, Noah and Jason for top-notch work from the beginning to the end. This was a big  project for my household and it went smoothly. I will refer and recommend All About The Pipes to anyone looking for a full service plumber!

reviews.author: michael valle
reviews.text:
We had a very stressful situation where I exhausted every DIY option I could with no success.  I really didn't want to call a plumber because my last estimate (from one of the big companies in town) was shocking.

But alas we had to do something.  All about the pipes came recommended on reddit and I gave them a call.

When Mary answered the phone she didn't make my stress disappear, BUT she shared the stress with me.  She asked very thoughtful questions and made me feel like someone was looking out for our family.

She sent Jason over and he was extremely professional and informative.  He did what he could but let us know our 80yr old plumbing infrastructure was on its last leg.

We asked him for an estimate to do a considerable task.  And when we received the figures we were pleasantly surprised how reasonable it was.  So much so we added a few other tasks to the service.

On the actual day of the work Jason and Noah arrived and worked as a team to not only get the job done, but also in a timely manner and no mess left behind.

I HIGHLY RECOMMEND All about the pipes!

Plumbing problems are no fun and we customers can be in a very vulnerable position bc I have no idea why the big boys would be exponentially more expensive than what All about the pipes charged.

THANK YOU Mary, Jason, and Noah for helping our family! If y'all have a plumbing problem I hope you call them to help yours.

I'm glad they are in our community and will call them if we need anything else 😁

reviews.author: Susan Allen
reviews.text: Not only are you getting great service, you will be dealing with great people.  Mary and her crew have come to my rescue twice this year and have shown that this business is truly about community.  You can trust the repair will be done correctly and efficiently.  From scheduling appointments all the way through completing the service call, All about the Pipes is all about quality!

reviews.author: Brandon Tegey
reviews.text: In a word WOW. Some background here. I got quotes from 3 other places to get two EV Chargers installed. My family has used Travis Crawford and had great results but I never knew they had an electric branch. Unlike all the other places when Dillon arrived from Travis Crawford, not only did he actually care and have an engaging conversation about the scope of work but he offered honest and helpful options for me. He was also aware of the chargers from Grizzl-E that I was wanting to use. He didn't overprice but quoted based on what I was looking for. On top of that he helped me get on a service plan for my plumbing and HVAC to ensure my whole home is taken care of. This is by FAR the best customer service I have received from first call to schedule service to finishing the job today. I can honestly say I trust these people with my home and family's safety as electrical work is no joke. This is what good work and honest people look like.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Bennett
reviews.text:
Travis Crawford consistently delivers exceptional and polite service. Our technician, Chris, was very communicative and punctual, and always considerate and cleanly when in our home. He took the time to explain things in detail and it never felt like he was selling more than the maintenance required. Behind the scenes, Leslie and team were proactive at letting us know when our parts had arrived and were quick to get us back on the schedule.

We have used Travis Crawford for both HVAC and plumbing needs, and will continue to do so. I highly recommend partnering with them!

reviews.author: SmokeWagon 69
reviews.text:
Chris and Kyle were awesome and made every effort to accommodate our needs and get us going with the best system possible.  Chris was prompt and courteous and answered all
of our questions.  We called on Travis and his team 10 years ago to replace our HVAC system in our previous home.  Because of the excellent service we received then, I didn’t hesitate to call them for the same thing this time.  Nothing has changed.  Travis and his team are still great!

reviews.author: David Joyner
reviews.text: Highly recommend this company. They have it together on their dispatch and customer service team. We were especially pleased with the service we got from JT Swain at Travis. He is knowledgeable, friendly, and solved our problem very quickly. Since we were new to this house he did a quick but thorough evaluation of our HVAC units and it became a no-brainier to put them under maintenance contract with the company. JT is an asset to Travis Crawford and I hope to work with him on all of our HVAC needs in the future.

reviews.author: Paul Redman
reviews.text:
We were definitely overdue to replace our water heater. It wasn’t failing yet, but it was so old that it couldn’t really be serviced anymore. Travis Crawford walked us through several replacement options, all of which came with at least a 6 year warranty, which gave us a lot of peace of mind.

The office team was incredibly easy to work with and communicated clearly before, during, and after the install. Ricardo was the lead plumber and did a fantastic job from start to finish. Even better, they handled the install in the middle of an ice storm without a single issue.

They replaced our 15 year old unit with a brand new, higher efficiency water heater in right around two hours. I feel really good about both the price and the decision to work with Travis Crawford. At 16 years old, our old unit could have gone at any time.

Pro tip: flush your water heaters, people! We’ll absolutely use Travis Crawford again.

reviews.author: Colter james
reviews.text: We loved our experience with Travis Crawford. The only reason I knew who this company was, was because I still listen to the radio.  You’re gonna get exceptional service quality product without having to pay the big box store Morris Jenkin type prices. Travis Crawford had next day service and 1 day installation of a full HVAC system. They are also going to find you the best financing available (we got 0% interest for 60 months for $13,394) and they’ll make sure you get all the rebates from either Piedmont Natural Gas or Duke energy or whoever your utility provider is. Our next need will probably a new water heater. Travis Crawford will be our first call. The amazing employees were Joseph Pavlov; Cody Henry; and Jonathon Smith.

reviews.author: C E Ross
reviews.text: Trey assessed my air conditioning and furnace to determine repair or replacement status. He was very professional and knowledgeable. I appreciate his honesty about my system and the fact that he showed me the areas that had issues. I haven't received the quote yet, but Trey did provide an verbal estimate after speaking with their Comfort team. So far, my interaction with theTravis Crawford sraff has been positive!!

reviews.author: Giovanni Gilland
reviews.text: I have a Carrier infinity unit and it is a great unit. I’ve had some communication issues with my thermostat and the unit itself. I’ve had another company doing the maintenance on it over the years  and I lost faith in them. My wife and I were talking about how we needed to get the thermostat looked at again because of the thermostat rebooting. I have been very reluctant to let anyone touch the unit after I lost faith in the other company. So the next morning I was getting ready for work and was having a talk with the good lord above about how I felt about calling someone to come look at the unit, because sometimes they hurt you more than they help you and most technicians do not know how to work on a carrier infinity unit. I get in my truck the radio came on and a song I do not care for was playing. I hit the seek button and the next voice I hear is Travis Crawford  telling me about how he’s not good at predicting the weather and would I rather be safe than sorry for not getting my unit looked at. I said okay lord I hear you, I will call them when they open. I called and I got Jasmine, on the phone and her voice is very calming, I needed that. She listen to me talk about my feelings on someone working on my unit in fear it would be worse when they left. She went and as someone did they work on infinity units and they do. She got me set up with a service appointment. Chris Nichols called me about 25 mins before he arrived. When he got here he was very professional. My 3 Basenjis and cat lucky approved him right off. He asked what was going on with the unit. I told him and he listened. He checked some things out and figured out that it might be the drain on the air handler being stopped up causing it. It was really gummed up,  So he cleaned that out and gave me his number and said call him and keep him updated if the thermostat is still have the problem. What made me feel the best about the experience was all the things he explained to me about how my unit works and if everything was exactly right it could a lot of different things to go wrong.  I know more about my HVAC unit now than I ever have and Chris wasn’t here but an hour. I’m very happy with Travis Crawford and the they handled my whole experience.

reviews.author: Brendan Williamson
reviews.text:
I had an excellent experience with South End Heating and Air, especially their technician, Robert. Our hot water heater suddenly stopped producing hot water, and Robert quickly came out to diagnose the issue. From start to finish, he was professional, knowledgeable, and incredibly thorough.

What stood out most was how effectively he managed the entire situation and took the time to ensure everything was fully resolved before leaving. He explained the problem clearly, worked efficiently, and made sure the hot water heater was functioning properly at the end of the visit.

It’s rare to find someone who genuinely cares about doing the job right and seeing it through completely. I truly appreciate Robert’s professionalism and attention to detail. Highly recommend South End Heating and Air and would absolutely use them again in the future

reviews.author: Kenneth Robertson
reviews.text: Call, come out and replace my sewer. He was very respectful. He has explained everything well to me. And made sure I could understand everything that he was doing. Yeah, it was a great price. A great company to work for and he takes pride in the work that he does.It's hard to find that nowadays

reviews.author: Gwendylene Enow Tanyi
reviews.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

South End Plumbing Heating & Air came out quickly and did a great job repairing the pilot light on my water heater. They were professional, honest, knowledgeable, and explained everything clearly without trying to upsell unnecessary work. The technician was respectful, efficient, and had my hot water back up and running fast.

It’s hard to find dependable companies these days, but these are genuinely good working folks who care about doing the job right. I truly appreciate their service and would definitely recommend them to anyone needing plumbing or HVAC help.

reviews.author: Paul Branham
reviews.text: South End Plumbing did a great job solving our plumbing issues. They were able to get out to us to quote and start the job the same day, and when they found additional issues, they communicated quickly and were very fair with the cost changes that needed to be approved. Highly recommend them!

reviews.author: John Knower
reviews.text: Robert and the entire team at south end plumbing were top tier from the customer service to the craftsmanship! It’s nice to finally have “a guy” when it comes to a plumber. I will be using south end plumbing for all my needs moving forward.

reviews.author: Ty Hitt
reviews.text: South End did a great job on my plumbing tasks. From the prompt call back with detailed information to set the expectations, all the way to the work itself. Stan Hambrick performed the work and was very open about the extent of the repairs needed up front. Good communication and quality work, thanks Stan and Southend Plumbing.

reviews.author: Cheryl Grice
reviews.text: Southend Plumbing operates with the highest degree of integrity.  I am very pleased with the service received.  They have displayed the work performed will always supersedes expectations.  They had to replace the cover to my water meter and went the extra mile to ensure it was correct in size and it was what I requested.  They come highly recommended

reviews.author: Caroline Peters
reviews.text:
Very poor experience. Had a leak under the sink, they sent out 3 different men 3 different times. Each one just tightened a nut. Each time dirty disposal water gushed into my kitchen. I asked for a refund and they refused. Manager, Lauren stopped returning my calls. Had a local plumber come and he replaced the pipe in minutes, and it been fine ever since.

Caused a lot of water damage and ruined 3 rugs. They did nothing for me.

reviews.text: We had a pipe burst under our kitchen sink. 24 HR Emergency Plumber Charlotte arrived quickly and did a fantastic job with the repair and cleanup.
